Description

Aldenham School Sports Centre has excellent badminton facilities for anyone looking in the Hertfordshire/North London area. They have a total of 9 badminton court, posts and nets are included. Leagues and clubs can operate from the venue, as well as casual games with friends/colleagues.

Aldenham School Sports Centre provides free parking on site to those who are travelling by car or motorcycle. The nearest transport links to the venue by train are as follows:

From London
London - St Pancras International (Thameslink) to Elstree & Borehamwood and a 5 minute taxi to the School. Trains run every 20 minutes and the journey takes 20-25 minutes.

From the North West:
Majority of the InterCity trains stop at Watford Junction on the way into Euston. The school is a 10 minute taxi ride from Watford. Please not that you should instruct the driver to go to the School and not the village of Aldenham.

Directions by Tube:
Jubilee Line to Stanmore and taxi from the station.

The venue is open to the public to come and play on a one-off basis.

If you would like to secure your booking on a regular basis a block booking option is available for customers. This takes away the hassle of paying each session with one upfront fee and secures the booking for a number of weeks.

Please adhere to all terms and conditions of Aldenham School Sports Centre

If you need assistance on the day of your booking please call the site phone: 07857 915362
